coverage: 48 contiguous states plus District of Columbia; Alaska, Hawaii, and Puerto Rico excluded
index_definition: For each county, standardize each supplied adverse ACS proportion across all 3,108 counties using population standard deviation (z=(x-mean)/SD); EDI z mean is the unweighted arithmetic mean of the six component z-scores; edi_score = 50 + 10*edi_z_mean. Higher values indicate greater relative economic distress.
interpretation: edi_score is a relative cross-county index, not a percentage or dollar measure. Component indicators are treated as adverse directionally and weighted equally after standardization.
